tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “What does a plumber do?”
B hears the question and builds the answer. Choose the right word from the tile who / which: who for people, which for things. Put an -s on the blue verb.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Who for people, which for things. That works for both.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
